intro: Open the channel, check the frame, and make a still or a clip from one photo or a product link. A clip can include a script, an AI actor, a voice, captions, and music.

faq.q: Which channel should I make a file for first?
faq.a: Start with the channel that already gets your orders. Make that frame, post it, then make a second frame from the same photo if you sell somewhere else too.

faq.q: Can one vertical clip run in more than one full-screen placement?
faq.a: A 9:16 clip is the frame those full-screen placements share. You still export it once per job and upload it yourself in each ad account. Check each channel's current file rules before you launch.

faq.q: What frame should a feed still use?
faq.a: Use a square still. Photos from this tool are square. It does not export a 4:5 still, or a 4:3 or 3:4 still. If the feed wants 4:5, crop the square file in your editor, then upload it.

faq.q: How long can a clip be?
faq.a: 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds. Credits are 24, 40, 60, and 120. The cost is shown before you start, and a failed job returns its credits.

faq.q: What should I make for a marketplace listing?
faq.a: Lead with a square still on a plain background for the main image, then add a detail or lifestyle still. A clip is optional and usually sits beside the gallery, not in the main-image slot.

faq.q: What should a store gallery use?
faq.a: Keep gallery stills square so the grid lines up. Add a short clip when motion explains the product better than another still.

faq.q: Can you publish the file to my ad account?
faq.a: You can publish the finished file to TikTok or Meta in one click. You can also download it. Audience, budget, and schedule still live in the ad account. Type the price so it matches the live offer.

faq.q: Can one file run on every channel unchanged?
faq.a: The product can stay the same. The frame usually should not. A square listing still and a 9:16 clip are two jobs from one photo.

faq.q: How do I keep the product off the channel's buttons?
faq.a: Leave space around the product in a 9:16 clip, and check the file on a phone before you pay for traffic. The exact button layout changes by channel.

faq.q: Do I need a separate clip for every channel?
faq.a: Make a separate file when the frame changes. Two channels that both take 9:16 can use the same download if their file rules match.

faq.q: Can I use the download in paid ads?
faq.a: Yes. Finished files can be used commercially and have no watermark. Music can come from the library. You are responsible for the claims in the line.
Captions are written on the clip. Edit them in the built-in editor so the price matches the live offer. You can still change the post text in the ad account.

faq.q: Can one batch cover more than one channel?
faq.a: Yes. Run a batch from the same photo when the frame changes. Two channels that both take 9:16 can share one download if their file rules match. Each job shows its credit cost.

faq.q: Does the clip include a voice?
faq.a: Yes, when you write a line and pick an AI actor or a voice. The speech is generated. It is not a customer review.

faq.q: Can my own tools start a channel file?
faq.a: Yes. The API can start a photo or video job. The credit cost matches the same job in the project.

m2.h2: How to make a channel file in 3 steps

m3.lead: Open the channel you post on. TikTok, Instagram and Reels, Facebook, YouTube Shorts, Amazon, and Shopify each show the frame they expect.

benefits_h2: What the Channel File Can Include

benefits.d: Describe the product and the channel. The AI drafts the spoken line, and you edit it.
Use an actor when you do not want to be on camera. The person is generated, not a customer.
Put a track under the clip and swap it in the editor.
Captions arrive on the file. Change them so the price matches the live offer.
Paste a public product page. Its main image and name start the clip for this channel.
Photos are square. A clip can be 9:16, 1:1, 16:9, 4:3, or 3:4, at 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds.

steps_h2: How to make a channel file in 3 steps
steps_lead: Add a photo or a link, pick the frame, then publish or download.

steps.d: Upload one photo or paste the product page for the channel you sell on.
A photo is square. For a clip, pick 9:16, 1:1, 16:9, 4:3, or 3:4.
Send the file to TikTok or Meta, or download it and type the price yourself.

closing.h2: Check the File Before You Pay for Traffic
paras: Play the clip on a phone and read the captions before you spend on a campaign. Plans start at $24.50 a month for 200 credits. Pro is $35 for 300, and Premium is $63 for 600.
A photo is 24 credits. A video is 24, 40, 60, or 120 credits for 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds. You see that cost before the job starts.
